summary:
Implementation plan to incorporate key features from the mock UI attachments into PyCert:
- Comprehensive Home Dashboard with exam readiness gauge, daily flashcard quick-drill, and syllabus progress matrix
- Interactive IDE Lab Specifications with Modulo/Algorithm diagrams, acceptance criteria, and automated PyTest test matrix
- Portfolio Capstone Manager with Git remote host telemetry and pre-flight audit checklist
- Top navigation bar enhancements with PCEP topic search and student profile indicator
- Warm Navy, Cream, and Charcoal palette enriched with subtle burgundy accents
